payload.friendly_name: troupe configuration: remote includes and a schema
payload.purpose_context: Step 7 adds the Remote includes and schema contract section. Teams share configuration by including it from a URL; troupe fetches it on load, refuses to change values that come from it and tells the user which include line to change instead. A JSON Schema in .troupe/troupe.schema.json describes the configuration: the loaded configuration must validate against it, settings marked format uri and values tagged !literal are taken literally rather than as includes, and set writes include-looking strings as literals unless --include is given.
payload.purpose_tldr: Configuration can include shared team settings from https:// URLs, read-only to troupe, and a JSON Schema describes the configuration so URL settings are never mistaken for includes.

options: file: resolves against the remote URL (fetched from the same server); nested https:// includes allowed; a URL cycle exits 4
Remote files may contain https:// includes but a file: include in remote content exits 4
Remote files may contain no includes at all (any include string in remote content exits 4)
payload.question: A remote YAML include (https://…/team.yaml) itself contains include strings — file:x.yaml, or another https:// URL. What do they mean?

payload.final_answer: Agent choice (out of contract, product owner 2026-10-07): option A — a file: include inside fetched content resolves against the remote URL (RFC 3986) and is fetched; nested https:// and http:// includes are allowed; a URL cycle exits 4; everything reached through a remote include is remote and read-only.
